name: Mend
one_liner: Mend is an enterprise-grade telehealth platform focused on patient engagement and reducing no-shows with AI-powered predictive analytics and automated outreach.
best_for: Healthcare organizations seeking to reduce no-show rates
Multi-specialty practices needing robust patient engagement automation
Behavioral health and mental health organizations with high patient volumes

short_description: Enterprise telehealth platform with AI-powered patient engagement and predictive no-show analytics. Designed for high-volume healthcare organizations.
long_description: Mend is an enterprise telehealth and patient engagement platform that differentiates itself with AI-powered predictive analytics to reduce patient no-shows. Founded in 2014, the platform uses machine learning to identify patients at high risk of missing appointments and triggers automated outreach via SMS, email, and voice to improve attendance rates. Mend offers HIPAA-compliant video visits, virtual waiting rooms, digital forms and intake, and seamless EHR integration. The platform supports both synchronous video visits and asynchronous telehealth workflows. Mend is particularly popular among behavioral health organizations, FQHCs, and multi-specialty practices that struggle with no-show rates. The company claims to reduce no-shows by up to 35% through its predictive engagement technology.

faqs.q: What makes Mend different from other telehealth platforms?
faqs.a: Mend differentiates itself with AI-powered predictive analytics that identify patients at high risk of no-shows. The platform automatically triggers personalized outreach via SMS, email, and voice to improve attendance rates. Mend claims to reduce no-shows by up to 35%.

faqs.q: Is Mend suitable for small practices?
faqs.a: Mend is primarily designed for larger healthcare organizations, FQHCs, and multi-specialty practices with high patient volumes. The enterprise pricing model and implementation requirements make it less suitable for solo practitioners or small practices.

faqs.q: What EHR systems does Mend integrate with?
faqs.a: Mend integrates with major EHR systems including Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, NextGen, eClinicalWorks, Allscripts, Greenway, and Meditech. The platform supports HL7 and FHIR standards for interoperability.

faqs.q: Does Mend work for behavioral health?
faqs.a: Yes. Mend is popular among behavioral health and mental health organizations. The platform's no-show reduction capabilities are particularly valuable for mental health practices, which often experience higher no-show rates than other specialties.
